title: Native Weil dualizing Hom and its constructible coefficient realization
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X$ put $\bar X=X\times_{k_0}k$ and let $g_{\bar X}$ be geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. On the small pro-etale site of $\bar X$, let $R_{\bar X}$ be the coefficient sheaf whose sections on a quasi-compact object $V$ are continuous functions $|V|\to\Omega$ with values in one finite intermediate extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$; on general objects impose this condition locally [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Write $\mathcal A_{\bar X}=\operatorname{Mod}(R_{\bar X})$ for its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\mathcal B_{\bar X}$ for pairs $(F,\theta:g_{\bar X}^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}F)$ in $\mathcal A_{\bar X}$, with intertwining morphisms [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Derived categories mean localization of complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\mathrm{WC}(X)\subset D(\mathcal B_{\bar X})$ be the full subcategory with bounded cohomology whose underlying cohomology sheaves admit a finite locally closed stratification with pro-etale locally finite free restrictions over $R_{\bar X}$. This is the native category `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex`, not the category of fixed pairs in $D(\mathcal A_{\bar X})$.

Let $a_0:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ be the structure morphism and let $Ra_{0!}^{\mathrm W}:\mathrm{WC}(X)\to\mathrm{WC}(\operatorname{Spec}k_0)$ be the native compact-support functor `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.derivedLowerShriek`, formed from equivariant open extension by zero and proper direct image along a compactification [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Assume that $Ra_{0!}^{\mathrm W}$ has a right adjoint $Ra_0^{!,\mathrm W}$ on $\mathrm{WC}$, as in `WeilComplex.HasUpperShriek`. Put $\omega_X=Ra_0^{!,\mathrm W}\Omega^{\mathrm W}$, where $\Omega^{\mathrm W}$ is $R_s[0]$ with its canonical Frobenius pullback isomorphism at $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. For $K,L\in D(\mathcal B_{\bar X})$ let $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal B_{\bar X}}(K,L)$ be the native derived internal Hom `ProEtaleWeilSheaf.derivedHom`: choose a K-injective resolution $L\to I$ in complexes over $\mathcal B_{\bar X}$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and take the product total complex $\prod_p\mathcal Hom_{R_{\bar X}}(K^p,I^{p+n})$ of internal Hom sheaves of $R_{\bar X}$-modules, each with the contragredient Weil structure $\theta_I\circ(-)\circ\theta_K^{-1}$ (through the canonical isomorphism $g^*\mathcal Hom(A,B)\cong\mathcal Hom(g^*A,g^*B)$ for the automorphism $g=g_{\bar X}$). 

Put $Y=\bar X$, $\mathcal C_Y=D^b_c(Y,\Omega)$, the common finite-coefficient-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], with raw rationalizations [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and $\omega_Y=Ra_Y^!\Omega$ for $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, using the constructible exceptional functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Write $D_YM=R\mathcal Hom(M,\omega_Y)$ for the coefficient-passage internal Hom [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $\rho_Y:\mathcal C_Y\simeq D^b_{\mathrm{cons}}(\mathcal A_Y)$ be the evaluation-normalized coefficient realization [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization], and $U:D(\mathcal B_Y)\to D(\mathcal A_Y)$ the termwise forgetful functor [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful]. Here $D^b_{\mathrm{cons}}$ means bounded cohomology whose sheaves have a finite locally closed stratification with pro-etale locally finite free restrictions over $R_Y$. Fix an inverse equivalence to $\rho_Y$, including its unit and counit. For $K\in\mathrm{WC}(X)$ set $M_K=\rho_Y^{-1}UK$ and denote its counit isomorphism by $j_K:\rho_YM_K\xrightarrow{\sim}UK$. Write $H_XK=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal B_Y}(K,\omega_X)$ in the ambient native derived category.

Let $h:U\omega_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\rho_Y\omega_Y$ be the isomorphism of [lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful] for $f_0=a_0$ and the specified right adjoint, normalized by the exceptional-adjunction counit and the identification of the constant Weil sheaf at the point with the coefficient unit. There is a natural isomorphism, for every native $K$,
$$c_K:UH_XK\xrightarrow{\sim}\rho_YD_YM_K.$$
It is the following specified composite: the native forgetful Hom comparison $UH_XK\cong R\mathcal Hom_{R_Y}(UK,U\omega_X)$, followed by the Hom map induced by $j_K$ in the first variable and $h$ in the second, followed by the inverse of the evaluation-transpose realization comparison $\rho_YD_YM_K\cong R\mathcal Hom_{R_Y}(\rho_YM_K,\rho_Y\omega_Y)$. The object $D_YM_K$ belongs to $\mathcal C_Y$, and $UH_XK$ has bounded constructible cohomology. The comparisons are natural for all native derived morphisms, including extension morphisms. Under the tensor comparisons and $j_K$, the evaluation $UH_XK\otimes^{\mathbf L}UK\to U\omega_X$ becomes the realized evaluation $\rho_YD_YM_K\otimes^{\mathbf L}\rho_YM_K\to\rho_Y\omega_Y$ after postcomposition by $h$.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-ordinary-closed-presentation to the given compatible closed model N. Its two natural isomorphisms and the evaluation-transpose normalization construct Presentation, independently of the native exceptional adjoint. Fix any such T thereafter.

Apply lem-sf-structural-omega-hom-pairs to the specified structural system and compactification, at V(K). These permitted pairs define coefficientHom by the actual common-stage internal Hom lift. The realized Hom comparison beta is invertible by the given realization data. The specified Package gives omegaComparison with the exceptional counit normalization.

Use T.alpha, then ambientHom applied to the pair of counit and omegaComparison isomorphisms, then inverse beta. Naturality of alpha is the naturality of three whiskered isomorphisms: the native Hom model, native forgetful Hom comparison and T.hom. After composing with beta, its naturality and counit naturality identify both composites. NatIso.ofComponents therefore gives a comparison on every native derived morphism. Its displayed composite follows by cancellation of beta inverse with beta.
The realization image criterion transfers bounded constructibility from the actual realized coefficientHom object to the isomorphic native Hom object, using the inverse comparison as the witness.

Uncurry T.hom_normalization. Naturality of T.tensor inverse and the native evaluation clause of N.Compatible show that inverse composite tensor comparison followed by forgotten native evaluation equals tensor of transported native Hom comparison followed by ordinary evaluation. The native-model isomorphism cancels its inverse in alpha. Evaluation naturality in j and h, followed by the given realization Hom evaluation law, is exactly the asserted square. This calculation uses neither faithfulness of U nor reflexivity.
